page.overview:
What is A Memory of Light?

A Memory of Light belongs to The Wheel of Time. Four excerpts of the final book have been released on the publisher's website, Tor.com.

An excerpt of the prologue on April 26, an excerpt of chapter one on July 15, an excerpt of chapter eleven on September 2, 2012, and an excerpt of chapter three on December 30, 2012. It was announced that the prologue of the book would be released as an e-book on October 2, 2012, however it was released early on September 19 due to accidental release in some regions. On September 26, 2012, the full text of chapter one was released on Tor.com.
